title: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Railway Operations Division ), 044-201-3976

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률」및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railway Logistics Industry and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(거점역 개량ㆍ통폐합 비용 지원 신청서) ① 「철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제3조제4항에 따라 거점역의 개량 및 통폐합 등에 필요한 비용을 지원받으려는 자가 국토교통부장관에게 제출하여야 하는 신청서는 별지 제1호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Support for Costs of Improvement and Consolidation of Hub Stations) ① A person seeking support for costs necessary for the improvement and consolidation of hub stations, etc., pursuant to Article 3(4) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railway Logistics Industry (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) must submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application in the form of Form No. 1 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청서를 받은 국토교통부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 신청인의 법인 등기사항증명서(신청인이 법인인 경우만 해당한다)와 사업자등록증명을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증명의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 해당 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다. <개정 2026. 9. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall verify the applicant ’s Certificate of Corporate Registration (only applicable if the applicant is a corporation) and Certificate of Business Registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant document. <Amended Sep. 15, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(철도물류의 정보화) 「철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제15조제2항제5호에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사업”이란 다음 각 호의 사업을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Informatization of Railway Logistics) In Article 15, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 5 of the “Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railway Logistics Industry” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the term “projects prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to the projects of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 철도물류의 정보화에 관한 연구개발 및 기술지원 사업
rows.text_en: 1. Research and development and technical support projects for the informatization of railway logistics

rows.source_ko: 2. 철도물류 관련 정보의 공동이용을 위한 데이터베이스의 표준화 및 호환시스템의 구축 사업
rows.text_en: 2. Project for the Standardization of Databases and Establishment of a Compatible System for the Joint Use of Railway Logistics-Related Information

rows.source_ko: 제4조(비용 보조 신청서) ① 영 제7조제2항에 따라 철도물류사업자가 국토교통부장관에게 제출하여야하는 신청서는 별지 제2호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Cost Subsidy) ①The application form that a railway logistics business operator must submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청서를 받은 국토교통부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 신청인의 법인 등기사항증명서(신청인이 법인인 경우만 해당한다)와 사업자등록증명을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증명의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 해당 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다. <개정 2026. 9. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall verify the applicant ’s Certificate of Corporate Registration (only applicable if the applicant is a corporation) and Certificate of Business Registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant document. <Amended Sep. 15, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(철도물류산업의 국제화) 법 제19조제4호에 따라 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 활동”이란 다음 각 호의 활동을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Internationalization of the Railway Logistics Industry) Pursuant to Article 19, Subparagraph 4 of the Act , “activities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to the activities of each of the following subparagraphs.
1. Conclusion of railway operation agreements between countries

rows.source_ko: 2. 국제 철도물류시설의 표준화에 관한 연구 및 기술개발
rows.text_en: 2. Research and Technology Development on the Standardization of International Railway Logistics Facilities
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 363, Sep. 23, 2016>
This rule shall take effect on September 23, 2016.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <국토교통부령 제1621호, 2026. 9. 15.> (법 체계의 정합성을 제고하기 위한 19개 법령의 일부개정에 관한 국토교통부령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 1621, Sep. 15, 2026> (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree on the Partial Amendment of 19 Laws to Enhance Consistency in the Legal System)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
